scope: Small VF-generated real-base specializations and complete Gamma-ground interfaces for unmeasured, bounded and measured lifts. The interfaces remain explicit and replaceable as parameters of the generic constructions. Same-ground essential measured groupoids, pointwise cofull representatives, graded and filtered presentation comparisons and the documented VF/Gamma-generated context applications are proved locally. Independently named disc imaginaries and concrete section 4 categories lie outside this section 3 certificate. The four measured interfaces are discharged by local proofs (see GAMMA-KERNEL-COMPLETION.md); as of November 18 the Gamma-ground unmeasured, Gamma-ground bounded and ordinary bounded interfaces are also produced (see their entries and GAP-REPAIRS.md). The ordinary global YinUnmeasuredLiftInput is produced as of November 19 (OrdinaryGlobalLiftInput.lean). Only the [19] YinGammaAffineInput (retained at its stated real VF-generated scope) has no producer.
